LESSON: GYMNASTICS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.6: Gymnastics

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Gymnastics. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why are sequences performed in Gymnastics?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the cartwheel skill in gymnastics
2. perform the cartwheel skill in gymnastics
3. perform 3-action sequence in cartwheel, forward roll and swan balance in gymnastics
4. appreciate the action sequence of gymnastic for enjoyment

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GYMNASTICS
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Gymnastics helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: GYMNASTICS
Study Gymnastics like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe the cartwheel skill in gymnastics

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the cartwheel skill in gymnastics. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the cartwheel skill in gymnastics.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Gymnastics” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the cartwheel skill in gymnastics. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Perform the cartwheel skill in gymnastics

What this means
In this part you learn to perform the cartwheel skill in gymnastics. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform the cartwheel skill in gymnastics.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Gymnastics in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform the cartwheel skill in gymnastics. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Perform 3-action sequence in cartwheel, forward roll and swan balance in gymnastics

What this means
In this part you learn to perform 3-action sequence in cartwheel, forward roll and swan balance in gymnastics. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform 3-action sequence in cartwheel, forward roll and swan balance in gymnastics.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform 3-action sequence in cartwheel, forward roll and swan balance in gymnastics. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Appreciate the action sequence of gymnastic for enjoyment

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the action sequence of gymnastic for enjoyment. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the action sequence of gymnastic for enjoyment.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Gymnastics” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the action sequence of gymnastic for enjoyment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Gymnastics is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Gymnastics” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe the cartwheel skill in gymnastics)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Gymnastics in your own words. (skill: perform the cartwheel skill in gymnastics)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: perform 3-action sequence in cartwheel, forward roll and swan balance in gymnastics)

Example 4: Show how “Gymnastics” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the action sequence of gymnastic for enjoyment)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Gymnastics to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the cartwheel skill in gymnastics.
3. Practise this skill: perform the cartwheel skill in gymnastics.
4. Practise this skill: perform 3-action sequence in cartwheel, forward roll and swan balance in gymnastics.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Gymnastics from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Gymnastics: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Gymnastics?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are sequences performed in Gymnastics?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Gymnastics means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the cartwheel skill in gymnastics.
5. Be able to: perform the cartwheel skill in gymnastics.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
